caseName: National Broadcasting Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: National Broadcasting Co., Inc. v. United States and Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc. v. United States

opinions.text: The motion for a temporary restraining order in each case is granted, and the stay entered by the District Court is continued until 10 days after the filing in the District Court of this Court’s mandates upon decision of the appeals. See 319 U. S. 190.
